### 1 — Scene
A chopped chicken salad with shaved hard cheese, vegetables, and a thick tan dressing. The exact protein and dressing are uncertain; I’m treating them as cooked chicken breast and creamy dressing.

### 2 — Vessel
A large stainless-steel bowl, approximately **26 cm in diameter**.  
Projected area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**. The dish at the left edge is excluded.

### 3–4 — Items and area
Visible foods: chicken pieces, shaved hard cheese (likely Parmesan), tan dressing, red onion, orange/red vegetable strips (likely carrot and pepper), and a few green leaves.

Estimated coverage is **63%** of the bowl’s projected area. The shares below divide the visible food footprint without counting overlapping areas twice.

### 5–7 — Volume, weight, and energy
Gross volumes use the outer envelope of each food pile; bulk density is the only adjustment for gaps.

| Item | Area share | Area × height = volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked chicken | 27% | 143 × 1.4 = 200 ml | 0.95 | 190 g | 165 | 314 kcal |
| Shaved Parmesan | 18% | 96 × 0.6 = 58 ml | 0.95 | 55 g | 420 | 231 kcal |
| Creamy tan dressing | 8% | 42 × 0.8 = 34 ml | 1.0 | 34 g | 350 | 119 kcal |
| Red onion | 3% | 16 × 1.0 = 16 ml | 0.6 | 10 g | 40 | 4 kcal |
| Carrot/pepper strips | 3% | 16 × 1.0 = 16 ml | 0.6 | 10 g | 35 | 4 kcal |
| Green leaves | 4% | 21 × 2.0 = 42 ml | 0.15 | 6 g | 20 | 1 kcal |

### 8 — Sanity check
**Approximately 305 g and 670 kcal** is plausible for this moderately sized, chicken-and-cheese-heavy salad. The few visible vegetables receive small weights. Cheese quantity and dressing composition are the largest sources of uncertainty; no unseen oil is added.
